message.content: Lion (Panthera leo) and zebra (Equus quagga) are both placental mammals that belong to the clade **Laurasiatheria**. Their last common ancestor was a small, shrew‑like mammal that lived roughly 70–90 million years ago, before the lineages that led to modern carnivores and odd‑toed ungulates split apart.
